missionEventData.data2: Fresh from their stunning success against the Invincible, the Alliance has found renewed hope in their struggle against the Empire. Joined by new allies from Sullust and Mon Calamari, Ace pilot Keyan Farlander and the Rebel Alliance must now continue the fight. But rumour has it that the Empire has a secret project of such awesome destructive power that it could destroy not only the Alliance but resistance itself.

missionEventData.data1: Our last mission wasn’t a success, but that’s only made High Command more eager to slow these convoys down until we can solve this mystery. High Command has selected a more traditional target. A convoy of freighters hauling heavy material. Using your Y-Wing starfighter, Red Squadron will drop in and destroy the convoy. Don’t worry about the cruisers or any of the convoy escorts. Just hit the convoy and hit it hard. While you hit the targets, Gold Squadron will fly cover in their X-Wings.
This is Red Leader. Ready to jump...
This is Gold Leader. All ships accounted for
Head to the jump point and good hunting!
Okay Red Squadron. Reinforce your shields and let's hit these transports one at a time. Lock on to that first transport and fire torpedoes!
That should leave a dent in the schedule!
Okay Red Squadron. Let's help Gold Squadron clear out those Star Wings.
Okay Red Squadron. Mission success. We have a clear run to the jump point. Let's take it.
Strafe the transport with lasers if you're out of torpedoes!
Ah, Lead, there's a Star Destroyer blocking our jump point.
Yeah, I see it. Recalculating jump point. We'll need to go around the Intrepid... And watch out for those Tie Fighers!

Good job! That certainly gave Imperial Security something to think about. We’re getting reports that all further convoys are being diverted. This level of speed and adaptability is disconcerting. But we’ll soon pick up the trace again. In the meantime somethings come up…
This is Gold Leader. We still have Star Wings active.
Gold Squadron. Accelerate to attack speed. Let's keep these Star Wings off our bombers.
TGS - M04 Assist the Rand Ecliptic
